verdict.rationale: Bun's docs say it does not run dependency lifecycle scripts such as `postinstall` by default, and you allow them per package via `trustedDependencies` (bun-docs-19, bun-docs-53, bun-docs-4). Related controls include `bun audit` with auto-fix (bun-docs-6, bun-docs-7) and `--frozen-lockfile` for reproducible installs (bun-docs-35). Missing for 10: no evidence of a minimum release age setting, and no independent or hands-on confirmation that script blocking works.
